_what: Keys OASiS names that do not resolve in the backend's own corpus.
_why: A baseline, not an allowlist. Every entry is a CANDIDATE awaiting triage, and each is either a real fabrication to fix or a correct negative the absence-cue matcher failed to recognise. The gate fails on anything NOT listed here, so a newly invented key is caught the moment it is written. Entries are removed as they are resolved; the list is meant to shrink to nothing.
_known_real_fabrications: fourc AREA0 - 4C has no such key; the reference geometry is DIAM (30 decks)
fourc FLUID_DYNAMIC / TURBULENCE_MODEL - 4C sections use SPACES: 'FLUID DYNAMIC' (561 decks), 'TURBULENCE MODEL' (57 decks)
_known_correct_negatives: fourc INTPOINTS_MORTAR - documented as NOT existing; 4C's key is NUMGP_PER_DIM
